ss.title: Start & search
ss.sub: Where each role opens after sign-in, how the search box and the badges behave, and the Dashboard's date choices.
ss.readOnly: You can look at these settings. Changing them needs the settings.write permission.
ss.helpersSub: Two small helpers for people who use the admin all day. Both are off until you turn them on.
ss.recent: Recent pages in the search box
ss.recentText: The empty search box lists the pages this person opened last, for them only.
ss.keysText: On a computer, press g and then a letter to open a section: g d opens the Dashboard, g o opens Orders. Typing inside a box is never taken as a jump.

start.d: The section a person opens on after sign-in, by their role. A role on the Dashboard opens the Dashboard. A person whose role cannot open the chosen section also lands on the Dashboard.
start.none: No roles yet. Roles are made in Team & roles.

search.d: How fresh the counts on the sidebar are, and how the search box answers.
search.badgeCacheSeconds: Count the sidebar badges again after (seconds)
search.badgeCacheSecondsHelp: 0 counts on every page. A bigger number is lighter on the server; the badge can be that many seconds old.
search.searchPerGroup: Results per group in the search box
search.searchPerGroupHelp: Pages, settings, products, orders and customers each show up to this many.
search.searchMinChars: Search products, orders and customers from (letters typed)
search.searchMinCharsHelp: Pages and settings are found from the first letter.

dash.d: The date choices above the money tiles, the hours the greeting changes and the small line inside each tile.
dash.rangesHelp: 1 = today. The first choice opens. Up to 5, each once.
dash.empty: No date choice. Add at least one.
dash.eveningHourHelp: Must be later than the afternoon hour. The store's own time zone.
dash.sparkDays: Days in each tile's small line

ss.unsaved: Some changes are not saved yet.

err.STALE: Someone else saved this card just now. It is shown again; make your change again.
err.forbidden: You may not change these settings.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.
